phase_history.notes: Nova One is a UX reinterpretation of Nova Master's original V1 mastering engine (PluginProcessor/ParameterIDs are byte-identical to commit ad97eab): one intelligent macro knob plus Clean/Warm/Wide/Loud mode selection replaces the five-slider workflow. Nova Master remains the full-featured advanced mastering suite; Nova One is the fast, one-knob enhancer.

New single-knob UI matching the approved mockup: contextual macro label/percentage/descriptor per mode, gold halo/glow animations, Output + Auto Level + Mix, Input/Output LUFS meters, True Peak, Ceiling Aware, preset prev/next, and a Meter View settings popover.

Forked CMakeLists/PluginProcessor/PluginEditor/ParameterIDs from Nova Master with identifiers renamed to Nova One (bundle id com.internationalnova.novaone, plugin code NvOn). DSP math in processBlock is untouched. Added two small additive pieces only: an input peak/RMS meter (mirrors the existing output meter) and a persisted auto_level bool parameter driving a client-side auto-gain nudge on the existing output_gain parameter. The macro knob maps its 0-100% position to the existing tone/glue/weight/air/width/output_gain/finish_mode parameters per mode, all client-side in index.html; no new DSP was written.
phase_history.notes_2: Verified in the Claude Browser preview pane (JUCE bridge absent, so the JS falls back to local state): mode switching, descriptor banding, ceiling readout, Auto Level toggle, preset cycling, meter callbacks, and both knob drags all behaved correctly. Full native build/DAW verification still needs a real JUCE/CMake toolchain run.

framework_selection.rationale: Reuses the existing JUCE WebView bridge pattern from Nova Master (WebSliderRelay/WebSliderParameterAttachment) so the new macro-knob UI can drive the untouched DSP parameters without any native-side processing changes.
